hangzhou-29.bio: Walled Jiangnan private garden beside West Lake on Yanggong Causeway, with ponds, pavilions and lake views.
hangzhou-29.ticket_note: no official site verified; operator is WeChat/ticket-phone only in search results
hangzhou-29.notes: 10 CNY from an undated Bendibao list and a 2017 Hangzhou news report; current price unverified. Bio details (ponds, pavilions) are generic and unverified beyond the draft: re-check.

anji-8.bio: Memorial hall in Changshuo Park, Anji, to the painter and calligrapher Wu Changshuo, who was born in the county.
anji-8.notes: UNRESOLVED: price/free and current visitor access not confirmed (search gave an old address, Tianmu Rd 572, and no fee). Recommend owner review or drop; cost left unverified.

yiwu-international-trade-city.bio: Giant wholesale market of small commodities in Yiwu, with five districts of stalls selling millions of products.
yiwu-international-trade-city.ticket_note: operator site not verified; yiwugo.com is a B2B platform, not used
yiwu-international-trade-city.notes: Free admission per Zhejiang culture and tourism dept page (2019, old). Draft claim 'every day of the year' not verified, dropped.

xiangshan-global-studios.bio: Film and television studio in Xinqiao, Xiangshan, with period-set streets and backlots used in Chinese productions.
xiangshan-global-studios.ticket_note: official site not found; no Wikipedia official link retrieved
xiangshan-global-studios.notes: 150 CNY list price from Ctrip only (weak). 'period-set streets' bio detail is generic, verify. 4A rated, 784,000 m2, opened 2005 per Wikipedia.

fangshan-geopark.bio: Volcanic plateau scenic area in Wenling with cliffs, the Nansong rock and Shifeng sections, east of Taizhou.
fangshan-geopark.notes: Located in Wenling, Changyu town; Ctrip says Fangshan, Nansongyan and Shifeng sub-areas. Price ~40 CNY from reseller and a 2021 review (weak). Claim that it is part of a global geopark (Yandangshan) is a user comment: unverified, bio avoids it; consider renaming 'Global Geopark'.

nansha-beach.bio: Mountain-backed sand beach on Zhujiajian island, Zhoushan, with roped swimming areas in summer.
nansha-beach.ticket_note: official site not found; operator uses WeChat reservation per search
nansha-beach.notes: Paid scenic area, 70 CNY adult (reseller + Ctrip, weak); a 2026 article cites ~75 and timed reservations, unverified. Reservation may be needed (needs not set).
